problems: Repair round 2026-10-25: 11 reviewer findings applied (french-mandate 3: interior double count, found counterpart, Levant Crisis names; pahlavi 4: Baluchestan gain turned into a 1928-1935 contest, Sheikh Khazal war removed, Tunbs circles, Azerbaijan month; hejaz-nejd 1: Najran gain deleted and 1932 keyframe corrected; sultanate-of-egypt 1: British protectorate pair; all-palestine-government 2: Egyptian vassal_start and the capitals note). The 4 findings already marked applied were left as they were. The three thin items for the Mandate (Cilicia date, Great Syrian Revolt, Paulet-Newcombe) were also worked from their pages.

Keyframes changed to agree with the ledger: french-mandate-for-syria-and-lebanon _1920 is now adjusted (1920 without the interior of Syria, which the Arab Kingdom holds to July 1920) and a new _1921 holds the full 1920 shape; kingdom-of-hejaz-and-nejd _1932 is now the 1926 shape (no Najran). The Cilicia occupation end and the strip loss moved from 1921-10 to 1922-01 (Franco-Turkish War page: evacuation completed 7 January 1922), which agrees with the 1922 shape.

Routed to other authors: ottoman-empire should date the Cilicia loss 1918-11 (landing at Mersin 17 November 1918, Franco-Turkish War page) not 1919, and lacks the Ankara strip; british-colonial-empire (eu-11) should mirror the 1918-10 Syria gain and the coast hand-over to France (the Mandate found counterpart is now british-colonial-empire); north-yemen /ledger/4 (1932 Najran loss) duplicates its 1934 loss and kingdom-of-saudi-arabia's 1932-1935 keyframe should exclude Najran until April 1934 (captured 21 April 1934, Treaty of Taif 14 June 1934); kingdom-of-hejaz /ledger/24 dissolve should name third-saudi-state, not emirate-of-nejd; united-arab-republic /ledger/4 should take Gaza from all-palestine-government rather than 'palestinians'; qajar-dynasty has no war entry for the Sheikh Khazal rebellion (late 1924) removed from pahlavi-dynasty; french-third-republic (eu-20) should carry the occupation of Cilicia from 1918-11.

Disagreements recorded in history/polities/_notes/me-10-h.md: the Levant Crisis page says only 'Syria' (the name 'Syrian Republic (1930-1950)' is the reviewer's, kept because second-syrian-republic opens in 1946); the Paulet-Newcombe page shows no Golan transfer to Palestine (the 1920 convention left the bulk of the Golan in the French sphere; the 1922 amendments moved the line north to include the Sea of Galilee and the Yarmuk valley); the Reza Shah page never mentions Sistan, so the Baluchestan contest excludes the Sistan region; the Abu Musa page dates the Iran-Sharjah memorandum to 30 November 1971.

Open-ended relations by design (validator warnings): kingdom-of-egypt Canal Zone occupation and Gaza vassal, all-palestine-government vassal toward kingdom-of-egypt, republic-of-turkey Cyprus and Syria relations. Two resolve warnings remain in pahlavi-dynasty (island circles).

The report's counts: events_total and sources_total cover all ten dossiers of the batch after the repairs; the previous report's counterparts list wrongly gave the Cyprus rows to me-10-h (they are eu-22 Cliopatria rows).
